title: Sumo-qa eval verdict
description: Schema for adversarial-judge verdicts produced by `codex exec` against a sumo-qa eval scenario.

verdict.description: Top-line pass/fail across all rubric items.

check.description: Short identifier for the rubric item, e.g. `shape_1: walks repo before asking` or `anti_2: surfaces classification label`.

pass.description: True if the check passed (expected-shape item satisfied, or anti-pattern absent). False otherwise.

evidence.description: Quoted span from the candidate response that justifies the call. 'not observed' if absent.

overall_evidence.description: One-paragraph summary justifying the top-line verdict, naming the most load-bearing PASS items and the most damning FAIL items.

worst_item.description: The `check` string of the single most damning failure (Iron-Law > discipline > anti-pattern). Empty string if verdict is PASS.
